findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default. Without rotation, the same key material is used indefinitely, increasing the impact of a potential key compromise on the audit trail data it protects.

No key_policy is defined for this KMS key, so AWS applies the default policy that grants the entire AWS account (all IAM principals with appropriate IAM permissions) full access to the key via 'kms:*'. For a key protecting an audit trail bucket, this violates least privilege and should instead be scoped to only the specific roles/services that need to encrypt or decrypt audit data.
